trial_court: Family Court, Dehradun, Original Suit No. 783 of 2021
case_name: Smt. Guddi Devi vs Sri Sanjay Dangwal
facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent filed a joint petition for waiver of the statutory cooling period of six months under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The trial court rejected their application.

legal_principles.principle: The court can waive the statutory period of six months under Section 13-B of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, after considering certain criteria.
legal_principles.held: Where the Court dealing with the matter, it is satisfied that a case is made out to waive the statutory period under Section 13-B of the Act, it can do so after considering the following:
cited_cases: Amardeep Singh vs. Harveen Kaur, (2017) 8 SCC 746

legal_principles.principle: The court should consider all efforts for mediation/conciliation before waiving the statutory period.
legal_principles.held: All efforts for mediation/conciliation including efforts in terms of Order XXXIIA Rule 3 CPC/Section 23(2) of the Act /Section 9 of the Family Courts Act to reunite the parties have failed and there is no likelihood of success in the direction by any further efforts:
cited_cases: Amardeep Singh vs. Harveen Kaur, (2017) 8 SCC 746

legal_principles.principle: The court should consider whether the parties have genuinely settled their differences before waiving the statutory period.
legal_principles.held: The parties have genuinely settled their differences including alimony, custody of children and other pending issues between the parties:
cited_cases: Amardeep Singh vs. Harveen Kaur, (2017) 8 SCC 746

legal_principles.principle: Waiving the statutory period will only prolong their agony if there are no pending issues.
legal_principles.held: The waiving period will only prolong their agony:
cited_cases: Amardeep Singh vs. Harveen Kaur, (2017) 8 SCC 746

outcome.final_order: The writ petition is allowed and the order impugned dated 18.09.2021 is quashed.

keywords: Smt. Guddi Devi vs. Shri Sanjay Gangwal
